title: Deep Sets and event-level maximum-likelihood estimation for fast pile-up jet rejection at the ATLAS High Level Trigger
abstract: arXiv:2512.10819v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multiple proton-proton interactions occur in the same bunch crossing at the LHC ("pile-up"), with the mean number of interactions per bunch crossing reaching up to about 60 in Run 3 and up to about 200 at the High-Luminosity LHC. As a direct consequence, hadronic activity within each bunch crossing increases, making it more difficult to identify collisions of interest pertaining to multijet final states. This work introduces DIPz, an uncertainty-aware Deep Sets-based machine-learning model that estimates each jet's origin along the beam axis as a Gaussian likelihood using the set of charged-particle tracks matched to the jet. Next, the DIPz predictions for each jet are combined into a likelihood-based event-level discriminant, which is optimised to select events compatible with a single collision producing a given jet multiplicity. translated_title: 用于ATLAS高层触发中快速堆叠喷注剔除的Deep Sets与事件级最大似然估计
translated_abstract: 在LHC中，同一次束团穿越会发生多次质子-质子对撞（即“堆叠”，pile-up），在Run 3期间每次束团穿越的平均对撞次数可达约60次，而在高亮度LHC阶段将高达约200次。其直接后果是每次束团穿越中的强子活动增加，使得识别与多喷注末态相关的感兴趣对撞变得更加困难。本工作介绍了DIPz，这是一种基于Deep Sets、具有不确定性感知能力的机器学习模型，它利用与喷注匹配的带电粒子径迹集合，以高斯似然的形式估计每个喷注沿束流轴方向的原点。随后，将DIPz对每个喷注的预测组合成一个基于似然的事件级判别量，该判别量经过优化，用于筛选与产生给定喷注多重数的单次对撞相容的事件。这种组合方法为堆叠剔除提供了一种稳健且计算高效的方法。
tldr: 本文提出DIPz模型，利用Deep Sets从带电粒子径迹中以高斯似然形式估计喷注的束流轴原点及其不确定性，并将各喷注预测组合成事件级最大似然判别量，为ATLAS高层触发实现快速且稳健的堆叠喷注剔除。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces DIPz, an uncertainty-aware Deep Sets model that estimates each jet's origin along the beam axis as a Gaussian likelihood from matched charged-particle tracks, and combines these predictions into an event-level maximum-likelihood discriminant for fast and robust pile-up jet rejection at the ATLAS High Level Trigger.
